answer: To join the harbor of trusted peers, an agent locks its pigment as collateral; sybils multiplying identities must replicate scarce enclave attestations, driving attack cost above any reward. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted once per verified hardware enclave, making fake identities costly to fabricate at scale. The oasis of honest participants then votes on slashing, so duplicate identities lose stake fast. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
